notes.title: New patch for GOD EATER!
notes.notes:
Hello God Eaters!

We just deployed a patch fixing a few bugs :)

God Eater Resurrection

The patch fixes:
•	Skipping movies when the windows movie player codec is not available (mostly Windows N users)
•	Game uses dedicated GPU by default
•	Lower network usage
•	Fixes ‘Enhance Pointer Precision’ bug
•	Fixes crash in urgent missions when Federico or Annette are selected (specific to God Eater Resurrection)

God Eater 2 Rage Burst

The patch fixes:
•	Skipping movies when the windows movie player codec is not available (mostly Windows N users)
•	Game uses dedicated GPU by default
•	Lower network usage
•	Fixes ‘Enhance Pointer Precision’ bug

Enjoy the game! We're always reading your threads so don't hesitate to leave feedback.
